it.ex_en: Substitute who took over the seat
Substitute who took over the seat

it.txt: Era vice-prefeito e assumiu a prefeitura em 27/03/2026, em solenidade no Centro Comunitário Dom José Carlos Melo, depois que Dr. Helder renunciou ao cargo para concorrer a deputado estadual na eleição de 2026.
it.txt_en: He was vice mayor and took over as mayor on March 27, 2026, in a ceremony at the Dom José Carlos Melo Community Center, after Mayor Dr. Helder resigned to run for state deputy in the 2026 election.

it.txt: Era vice-prefeito e tomou posse como prefeito em 26/03/2026, na Câmara Municipal, depois que Marília renunciou ao cargo para concorrer a senadora na eleição de 2026.
it.txt_en: He was vice mayor and was sworn in as mayor on March 26, 2026, at the City Council, after Mayor Marília resigned to run for senator in the 2026 election.
